newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn to issue up to 54 bln dmk of debt in Q1 97.
newsitem.headline: Bonn to issue up to 54 bln dmk of debt in Q1 97.

text.p: The German government plans to issue the following debt in the first quarter of 1997, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Thursday.
PAPER MATURITY VOLUME TIME OF ISSUE
Federal bond 10 years up to 15 bln dmk 1st 10 days
Treasury discount 6 months up to 11 bln dmk January 15
Top-up of federal 10 years up to 10 bln dmk 3rd 10 days
Treasury bonds 5 years up to 8 bln dmk 3rd 10 days
Treasury notes 2 years up to 10 bln dmk March 19
NOTE - The exact date of each issue will be announced one week beforehand, the Bundesbank said. The issue calendar for the second quarter of 1997 will be announced in the third 10 days of March.
